Smith Asset Management Group LP Raised Its Holding in Biogen INC (BIIB) as Stock Value Declined
May 26, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Investors sentiment increased to 1.17 in 2017 Q4. Its up 0.04, from 1.13 in 2017Q3. Since January 9, 2018, it had 1 insider purchase, and 5 selling transactions for $10.09 million activity. Sandrock Alfred also sold $266,444 worth of Biogen Inc. (NASDAQ:BIIB) shares. On Tuesday, January 9 the insider PANGIA ROBERT W sold $1.92M.
Smith Asset Management Group Lp increased its stake in Biogen Inc (BIIB) by 164.79% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Smith Asset Management Group Lp bought 138,832 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.01% with the market. The hedge fund held 223,079 shares of the biological products (no diagnostic substances) company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $71.18 million, up from 84,247 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Smith Asset Management Group Lp who had been investing in Biogen Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $60.39 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.63% or $1.8 during the last trading session, reaching $286.21. About 1.13M shares traded. Biogen Inc. (NASDAQ:BIIB) has declined 3.66% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.21% the S&P500.
Smith Asset Management Group Lp, which manages about $2.91B and $3.18B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 32,162 shares to 794,543 shares, valued at $134.51M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Paypal Holdings Inc by 131,590 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 815,040 shares, and cut its stake in Lear Corp (NYSE:LEA).
